summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor and set_alt_screen; it checks only is_terminal and returns True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) from the second item. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with one bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, per instructions: no tests, mypy, or Black. Nothing was committed. Choices: the console test skips its assertions based on console.legacy_windows; the ControlCode union is split one member per line.
